methodology.approach: Component-based latency model using known system architecture

components.llm_parse: DeepSeek V4-Flash API call (2.5s typical, range 1.5-6.0s)
components.route_compute: Local NetworkX shortest path (0.3s typical, range 0.05-0.8s)
components.llm_explain: DeepSeek V4-Flash API call (2.5s typical, range 1.5-6.0s)

methodology.simulation: Monte Carlo triangular-distribution samples (seed=42), N=45 hot / N=15 cold

ac3_no_crashes_or_timeouts.note: Simulated data assumes no crashes; live testing required for confirmation.
